Against `off_a` the wall gap is ~12.4 s per bench run versus ~6.3 s of measured hasher saving; against `off_b` it is ~5.5 s versus ~1.7 s. So hasher CPU is not independently additive to product wall — which is exactly what the reducer's own `limits` field states.
